title: The Secret of HOP: The Channel of Order and Three Pillars of Success
summary: Apologizing for a late update, President Hughes confirms the mission is secure with food and water storage and reminds missionaries to utilize their local priesthood channels by counseling with district and zone leaders. He shares the 'HOP' framework (Hardworking, Obedient, Prayerful), an acronym passed down from a highly successful missionary's grandfather. Grounded by an Ezra Taft Benson quote on the spiritual physics of hard work, he details how HOP serves as a universal formula for resilience and success both during the pandemic and long after the mission.
